questions: What does 'considering either their frequency or uniqueness' mean? Should the function have a parameter to choose between frequency and uniqueness, or is it just descriptive?
How should n-grams be tokenized? Should punctuation be removed, and should text be lowercased as in the reference solution?
If there are ties in frequency among n-grams, how should the top K be selected? E.g., alphabetical order, first encountered, arbitrary?
What should happen if top_k is larger than the number of distinct n-grams? Should it plot all available n-grams or raise an error?
Should the bar plot have any specific styling, title, axis labels, or ordering (e.g., bars sorted by frequency)?
Is the function expected to handle empty text strings? If so, what should be returned?
What if n is larger than the number of words in the text? Should it return an empty plot, raise an error, or something else?
Should the function close or reuse existing matplotlib figures? The reference creates a new plt.figure(), but is that required?
